# Public SDK snapshot

`actionlint-extension-api` is based on the public SDK from actionlint commit
`70c824363f307a5097e73531d18d00189cca6fe8` and includes its MIT license. The
[snapshot manifest](actionlint-extension-api.snapshot.json) records source blobs and file hashes.
The files match that revision without local changes. The snapshot contains no host implementation or
sibling-checkout dependency. Update the SDK as a unit. Do not update generated protocol sources independently.
